sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: release-tracks/many pageTypes: "Event-Date" (the synthetic column produced by the `eventParts` extractor, e.g. release-tracks' live-performance "Disambiguation" parsing, or work-recordings'/artist-relationships' "Comment" parsing) never showed the "Date info - Precision/Decade/Month/Year/Weekday" section family, because `_dateExprColumnNames()` only ever collected names from `dateParts`/`dateTimeParts` entries, never `eventParts`. Also extended the shared date-token match to recognize `eventParts`' own uncertain-day "YYYY-MM-DD/DD" shape (MusicBrainz's "recorded on one of these days" convention) as a complete date with no single resolvable weekday, rather than not matching it at all.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: release-tracks: the "Recorded at event" column's 📊 dropdown never showed the "Date info - Precision/Decade/Month/Year/Weekday" section family every other date-bearing column gets — the same gap the "Recording date" fix closed, but this column's own cell text is "<event name> (YYYY-MM-DD)", not a bare date, so `_findCellDateExpressionParts()` now also falls back to the cell's `.mb-credit-date` sentinel (the trailing date annotation) when the whole-cell text isn't itself a date expression.
